sources.note: No Firecrawl spend. The operator asked for the Gilroy look; sites/gilroy-roofing was built from astro-templates/owl, and the roofing library lists owlroofing.com as a `primary` role entry for that same template. The template source is local and authoritative, so it was read directly (astro-templates/owl/src/styles/tokens.css + the component CSS) instead of paying ~$0.02 to scrape a rendering of it. Brand tokens come from sites/results-roofing/intake-scraped.json.
sources.structural_reference: astro-templates/owl/ — fixed home order: hero → promise-bar → services-grid → testimonials → promise-band → signature-system → process-steps → about → seo-body → faq → blog-cards → closing-cta → footer
sources.palette_reference: sites/gilroy-roofing/src/styles/tokens.css — cool light bg, dark full-bleed bands, single warm accent. Shape adopted; values re-derived from the client's own brand.

palette_provenance.accent: #BA2A22 — the client's exact brand red, detected from their primary button fill and logo.
palette_provenance.primary: #062a6b — the client's brand blue #0047BA, deepened. #0047BA itself is a legitimate band colour (white on it is 8.05:1) but it leaves no headroom for an accent to sit on top; deepening to #062a6b buys 13.54:1 with white and lets a coral accent clear AA.
palette_provenance.accent_on_dark: #f4756a — a lightened tint of the same brand red, for accent-coloured TEXT on the dark bands. Not a new brand colour; the same hue at a luminance that survives a navy background.
palette_provenance.bg: #f4f6fa — cool near-white, mirroring gilroy's #f0f2f7 and reading as the blue side of their identity.

typography.note: Rubik is the client's own heading font, detected from their CSS — keeping it preserves brand recognition against their existing collateral. Their body font is Roboto Condensed; it is swapped for Inter because the owl template carries substantially more long-form body copy (SeoBody, service long_description, about story) than their current site, and condensed faces cost measurable readability at that length. Swap --font-body back to 'Roboto Condensed' if strict fidelity is preferred over legibility. Template default was Montserrat/Inter.

contrast_audit.method: WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance ratio, computed not estimated.

verified_pass.pair: white text on accent #ba2a22 (every button on the site)
accent #ba2a22 as text on bg #f4f6fa (eyebrows, ticks, pins)
accent #ba2a22 as text on white surface (quote-card stars)
white on primary #062a6b (all four dark bands)

rejected.why: Why --color-primary is not the raw brand blue.

rejected.pair: brand red on the deepened navy
rejected.why: Why a separate accent_on_dark token exists at all.
Even a black band cannot rescue it — this red is too dark to be accent text on any dark panel.

client_current_site.pair: their live primary button: #666666 label on #ba2a22 fill
client_current_site.why: A real failure on resultsroofing.com today. Explicitly not carried over.

gilroy_reference.pair: gilroy accent #f15537 with white button text
gilroy_reference.why: The Gilroy build's own buttons fail AA. Its palette SHAPE is the reference, not its values — this build does not reproduce that defect.

template_change_required.what: Add a --color-accent-on-dark token and point the five accent-as-text-on-dark-panel rules at it.
template_change_required.why: astro-templates/owl uses a single --color-accent for two incompatible jobs: button fills (needs to be dark enough for white text) and accent text on --color-primary bands (needs to be light enough to read on navy). The template already solved the mirror-image case by adding --color-accent-ink for light backgrounds; this is the same fix pointed the other way. Gilroy's palette happens to fail in the opposite direction — its orange reads on black but not on white — so the defect has simply changed sides, never been removed.
call_sites: HeroOwl.astro:178 .badge-copy .stars over the dark photo scrim
not_changed: HeroOwl.astro:212 .stars in the quote card — sits on --color-surface (white), where the brand red is already 6.1:1. Leave on --color-accent.
Every .btn, .icon and circular-counter fill — those are FILLS with --color-on-accent text and are correct as-is.
template_change_required.scope: Applied to the site copy at sites/results-roofing/src/components/ during site-generate. NOT written to astro-templates/ — design-reference is forbidden from touching the template, and upstreaming this belongs in its own change once it has shipped once.

avoid: generic construction stock photo (handshake, diverse team in hardhats, generic hard-hat closeup)
Lucide icon rows (max 1 outline icon per section, semantic only)
"Trusted by 10,000+ customers" without a real number from GBP
randomized section order — always use the fixed order from the template
a hero half-covered by a 12-field form before any trust is established (the defect on the client's current site)
a social-proof section that renders empty — testimonials must be baked into the content collection as real text, never loaded from a third-party review widget
labelling a section 'FAQs' and filling it with blog cards (the client's current home page does this)
more than one phone number in the rendered site — the client publishes nine
stacking a chat bubble, an instant-quote widget and a captcha overlay on first paint
any colour value taken from the client's existing site layout, component styling, or section rhythm — brand hex and font family only

_notes.anti_pattern_lock_respected: audit_results.json was read only for the `avoid` list (what to steer away from). No layout, section order, or component styling from resultsroofing.com informs this file.
